messages:
Maya L.: t-minus 30 for gateway-edge quiet window. Quick live checklist: canary pinned, smoke green, DB migrations check, rollback owners oncall, release notes published. Call any blocker immediately.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: `gateway-serving:v4.10-canary` (pin=pin-10042). Canary warmed to 10% traffic.

Omar K.: Ack rollback ownership. I'll run DB revert if needed. Rollback command is staged in my terminal.

Ben C.: I'm on metrics & serp checks. Smoke tests kicked off: unit smoke + e2e rerank. ETA ~4m.

Maya L.: Important: autoscaler policy changed in this release (PR #5012). We should watch scale events for the first 10m. If scale delays spike p95 > 150ms, we abort.

release-bot: Release notes published: /releases/gateway-edge/v4.10/notes (versioned draft). Changelog includes autoscaler tuning + embed quant change.

deploy-bot: Canary smoke results: unit-smoke PASS, e2e-rerank PASS, p95 74ms, errors 0.12%. Scaling start latency 40ms.

Ben C.: Dashboards look normal. No rerank score drift observed.

Omar K.: One config note: new heuristic flag `edge_rerank_mode` default=true in staging, false in prod. Confirming prod state...

Maya L.: @Omar K. please toggle to false in prod if it's true. We don't want scoring changes during quiet window.

Omar K.: Toggling now:
`curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags/edge_rerank_mode -d '{"value":false}'`
Flag set to false.

deploy-bot: Canary observing normal behavior. Streaming tests still running (ETA 3m).

Maya L.: Abort criteria (repeat): error rate > 0.6% OR p95 latency increase > 120ms OR any scaling failures. If triggered: Omar run rollback, Ben notify #release-war-room and ping oncall.

Omar K.: Rollback command (ready):
```
./ops/rollback --service gateway-serving --to-tag v4.9.7 --reason "quiet-window-trigger" --force
```

Ben C.: :thumbsup: monitoring alerts routed to eng-oncall. Runbook pinned: https://wiki.internal/releases/gateway-edge-backout

Maya L.: All green from me. Starting quiet window now. Please acknowledge when you see the freeze timestamp.

deploy-bot: Quiet window started at 6080808088. Canary remains pinned. Alerts forwarded to #eng-oncall.

Ben C.: Seen. Watching dashboards, setting a 20m active watch.

Omar K.: Standing by. If anything spikes I'll execute rollback and post logs.

Maya L.: Nice and steady so far. Good job team :tada:

release-bot: Final release notes snapshot saved (v4.10). Tagging release candidate for push after quiet window complete.
